title: Where Canadians live
hook: Canada has added 19.8 million people since 1971.
Three provinces account for 77% of the increase.
hookNote: Population on July 1 of each year, 1971 to 2026. 2026 is a preliminary estimate.

beats.text: Ontario: +472,089 in one year, the largest one-year increase by a province since 1971. Alberta: +4.6% again.

items.text: Canada, up 90% (2026 preliminary). Ontario, B.C. and Alberta: 77% of the increase.

lines.text: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0009-01: population estimates, quarterly (July 1 estimates). Statistics Canada Open Licence.
Column height shows population. Province colour shows growth from the year before. Every figure shown is a published value; movement between years is animation. 2026 is a preliminary estimate.
This video shows where population changed, not why.

sourceLine: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0009-01. Movement between years is animation.
method: Printed figures are published Statistics Canada July 1 population estimates for the year on screen. Column heights, province tints (growth from the previous July 1) and bar lengths move linearly between consecutive years as animation only; in-between states are never printed. 2026 is preliminary.
